english: Tap the camera to scan your first document.
target: Trykk på kameraet for å skanne ditt første dokument.
backtrans: Tap the camera to scan your first document.
S&H [??: abbreviation, presumably Black & White (svart-hvit), unclear/ampersand unusual in Norwegian]

english: Documents inside will not be deleted.
target: Dokumentene i mappen blir ikke slettet.
backtrans: The documents in the folder will not be deleted.
Give the folder a new name

english: No documents in this folder yet.
target: Ingen dokumenter i denne mappen ennå.
backtrans: No documents in this folder yet.

english: This folder is no longer available.
target: Denne mappen er ikke lenger tilgjengelig.
backtrans: This folder is no longer available.

english: This isn't automatic sync. Export creates a single encrypted backup file you move to your new device yourself, then import there.
target: Dette er ikke automatisk synkronisering. Eksport oppretter en enkelt kryptert sikkerhetskopi som du selv flytter til din nye enhet og deretter importerer der.
backtrans: This is not automatic synchronization. Export creates a single encrypted backup that you yourself move to your new device and then import there.

english: Could not import this backup. Check the password and try again.
target: Kunne ikke importere denne sikkerhetskopien. Sjekk passordet og prøv igjen.
backtrans: Could not import this backup. Check the password and try again.

target: Denne sikkerhetskopifilen ser ut til å være skadet.
backtrans: This backup file appears to be damaged.

english: {count, plural, =1{1 document imported} other{{count} documents imported}}
target: {count, plural, =1{1 dokument importert} other{{count} dokumenter importert}}
backtrans: {count, plural, =1{1 document imported} other{{count} documents imported}}

english: Pricing is still loading — try again in a moment.
target: Priser lastes fortsatt — prøv igjen om et øyeblikk.
backtrans: Prices are still loading — try again in a moment.
Give the document a new name

english: This scan is no longer available.
target: Denne skanningen er ikke lenger tilgjengelig.
backtrans: This scan is no longer available.

english: Something went wrong. Please try again.
This will undo all filters, rotations, crops, resizes, and eraser strokes on this page.
target: Dette vil angre alle filtre, rotasjoner, beskjæringer, størrelsesendringer og viskestreker på denne siden.
backtrans: This will undo all filters, rotations, crops, size changes and eraser strokes on this page. [??: 'viskestreker' = wiping/eraser strokes, slightly odd compound]

english: Front side captured. Now capture the back side.
target: Forsiden er skannet. Skann nå baksiden.
backtrans: The front side has been scanned. Now scan the back side.

english: Use your saved signature or draw a new one?
target: Bruke lagret signatur eller tegne en ny?
backtrans: Use saved signature or draw a new one?
Cross [??: 'Kryss' means cross/X, possibly intended as tick/check mark]

english: No documents to batch export. Scan some first.
target: Ingen dokumenter å batcheksportere. Skann noen først.
backtrans: No documents to batch export. Scan some first.

english: No folders yet. Create one from the home screen.
target: Ingen mapper ennå. Opprett en fra startskjermen.
backtrans: No folders yet. Create one from the start screen.

english: Copy text to clipboard after scan
target: Kopier tekst til utklippstavle etter skanning
backtrans: Copy text to clipboard after scanning

target: Spill av lyd når skanning er fullført
backtrans: Play sound when scanning is complete

target: Haptisk tilbakemelding når skanning er fullført
backtrans: Haptic feedback when scanning is complete

english: DOCX sources render poorly as pages — save inside the app is limited to JPG/PNG from image, PDF, TXT or CSV sources. Use Export & Share for this file.
target: DOCX-kilder gjengis dårlig som sider — lagring i appen er begrenset til JPG/PNG fra bilde, PDF, TXT eller CSV-kilder. Bruk Eksporter og del for denne filen.
backtrans: DOCX sources are rendered poorly as pages — saving in the app is limited to JPG/PNG from image, PDF, TXT or CSV sources. Use Export and share for this file.

english: To save inside the app, choose JPG or PNG. Other targets are exported as files.
target: For å lagre i appen, velg JPG eller PNG. Andre mål eksporteres som filer.
backtrans: To save in the app, choose JPG or PNG. Other targets are exported as files.
Justification [??: 'Justering' could mean adjustment or alignment]

english: Tap a spot to sample its color
target: Trykk på et sted for å ta fargeprøve
backtrans: Tap a spot to take a color sample

target: Feil ved generering av ID PDF
OCR ikke tilgjengelig på denne enheten.
backtrans: OCR not available on this device.

english: Your device doesn't support the advanced document scanner. Take a photo with your Camera app, then tap Import below to crop and save it.
target: Enheten din støtter ikke den avanserte dokumentskanneren. Ta et bilde med Kamera-appen og trykk deretter på Importer nedenfor for å beskjære og lagre det.
backtrans: Your device does not support the advanced document scanner. Take a picture with the Camera app and then tap Import below to crop and save it.

target: Fakturering ikke tilgjengelig — prøv igjen senere.
backtrans: Invoicing not available — try again later. [??: 'Fakturering' = invoicing/billing, odd for in-app purchases]

english: No internet. Connect once to download the language pack.
target: Ingen internettforbindelse. Koble til én gang for å laste ned språkpakken.
backtrans: No internet connection. Connect once to download the language pack.

english: Language pack downloading or not ready. Try again shortly.
target: Språkpakke lastes ned eller er ikke klar. Prøv igjen om et øyeblikk.
backtrans: Language pack is downloading or is not ready. Try again in a moment.

target: Skriv tekst for å fylle ut

english: YOUR DOCUMENTS STAY ON YOUR DEVICE
target: DOKUMENTENE DINE BLIR PÅ ENHETEN DIN
backtrans: YOUR DOCUMENTS STAY ON YOUR DEVICE

english: Your entire document office — scan, edit, sign, and export — in one private app.
target: Hele dokumentkontoret ditt — skann, rediger, signer og eksporter — i en privat app.
backtrans: Your whole document office — scan, edit, sign and export — in one private app.

english: Annotate, sign, watermark, fill forms, seal, and more — every tool free and unlimited.
target: Annoter, signer, vannmerk, fyll ut skjemaer, forsegle og mer — hvert verktøy gratis og ubegrenset.
backtrans: Annotate, sign, watermark, fill in forms, seal and more — every tool free and unlimited.

english: Use KatharScan in {count} languages. OCR runs on your phone — nothing ever leaves your device.
target: Bruk KatharScan på {count} språk. OCR kjører på telefonen din — ingenting forlater enheten.
backtrans: Use KatharScan in {count} languages. OCR runs on your phone — nothing leaves the device.

english: E-sign contracts, type-to-fill forms, and stamp enterprise seals in seconds.
target: E-signer kontrakter, fyll ut skjemaer og stempel bedriftssegl på sekunder.
backtrans: E-sign contracts, fill in forms and stamp company seals in seconds.

english: Every edit stays reversible — undo, redo, and revert to original anytime.
target: Hver redigering forblir reversibel — angre, gjør om og tilbakestill til original når som helst.
backtrans: Every edit remains reversible — undo, redo and reset to original at any time.

english: No account, no cloud, no watermarks. Your documents never leave your device.
target: Ingen konto, ingen sky, ingen vannmerker. Dokumentene dine forlater aldri enheten din.
backtrans: No account, no cloud, no watermarks. Your documents never leave your device.

english: Support KatharScan with a one-time purchase. All features remain free.
target: Støtt KatharScan med et engangskjøp. Alle funksjoner forblir gratis.
backtrans: Support KatharScan with a one-time purchase. All features remain free.

english: This is a non-consumable purchase. Restore it anytime on any device with the same store account.
target: Dette er et ikke-forbrukskjøp. Gjenopprett det når som helst på hvilken som helst enhet med samme konto i appbutikken.
backtrans: This is a non-consumable purchase. Restore it at any time on any device with the same app store account.

target: Takk for at du støtter KatharScan.

english: KatharScan ran into a problem displaying this screen. Your scans are safe — they're stored on this device and this doesn't affect them.
target: KatharScan støtte på et problem med å vise denne skjermen. Skanningene dine er trygge — de lagres på denne enheten og dette påvirker dem ikke.
backtrans: KatharScan encountered a problem with displaying this screen. Your scans are safe — they are stored on this device and this does not affect them.

target: Ingen skanninger samsvarer med søket ditt.

english: No folders yet. Tap the folder icon to create one.
target: Ingen mapper ennå. Trykk på mappeikonet for å opprette en.
backtrans: No folders yet. Tap the folder icon to create one.

english: No favorites yet. Tap the star icon on a document to add it.
target: Ingen favoritter ennå. Trykk på stjerneikonet på et dokument for å legge det til.
backtrans: No favorites yet. Tap the star icon on a document to add it.
F [??: single letter, Norwegian initial for 'Fet' (bold); would be B in English]
K [??: single letter, Norwegian initial for 'Kursiv' (italic); would be I in English]
Square [??: 'Firkant' = four-cornered shape/square, differs from 'Kvadrat' used elsewhere]
Ver [??: abbreviation, presumably 'value' (verdi) but 'Ver' is unclear/not standard]

english: Share it with friends who need a powerful document scanner.
target: Del det med venner som trenger en kraftig dokumentskanner.
backtrans: Share it with friends who need a powerful document scanner.

english: Your feedback helps us grow and keeps the app free.
target: Tilbakemeldingen din hjelper oss å vokse og holder appen gratis.
backtrans: Your feedback helps us grow and keeps the app free.
Cross [??: 'Kryss' = cross/X, possibly intended as check mark]

english: Welcome to KatharScan! This is the first public release featuring unlimited scanning, 29 languages, and export to PDF, Word, TXT, JPG, PNG, and CSV.
target: Velkommen til KatharScan! Dette er den første offentlige versjonen med ubegrenset skanning, 29 språk og eksport til PDF, Word, TXT, JPG, PNG og CSV.
backtrans: Welcome to KatharScan! This is the first public version with unlimited scanning, 29 languages and export to PDF, Word, TXT, JPG, PNG and CSV.

english: Allow background reminders for unexported documents
backtrans: Allow background reminders for non-exported documents

english: Allow the app to occasionally ask for a rating
target: Tillat at appen av og til ber om en vurdering
backtrans: Allow the app to occasionally ask for a rating

english: Allow the app to occasionally suggest sharing
target: Tillat at appen av og til foreslår deling
backtrans: Allow the app to occasionally suggest sharing

english: The pages could not be attached to the email. Use Share to send the pages.
target: Sidene kunne ikke legges ved e-posten. Bruk Del for å sende sidene.
backtrans: The pages could not be attached to the email. Use Share to send the pages.
Range [??: 'Område' = area/region, ambiguous for page range]

english: This document has no text yet. Run OCR on it first.
target: Dette dokumentet har ingen tekst ennå. Kjør OCR først.
backtrans: This document has no text yet. Run OCR first.

english: Your latest changes could not be saved.
target: De siste endringene dine kunne ikke lagres.
backtrans: Your latest changes could not be saved.

english: Tap the page where you want to type
target: Trykk på siden der du vil skrive
backtrans: Tap the page where you want to type

english: This PDF has {count} pages. Pages that are pictures are read with OCR (about 10 seconds each); pages with real text are instant.
target: Denne PDF-en har {count} sider. Sider som er bilder leses med OCR (omtrent 10 sekunder hver); sider med ekte tekst er umiddelbare.
backtrans: This PDF has {count} pages. Pages that are images are read with OCR (about 10 seconds each); pages with real text are immediate.
Clean [??: 'Ren' = clean/pure, unclear as name for sans-serif font]

english: Draw or type a new one
backtrans: Draw or write a new one
Range [??: 'Område' = area/region, ambiguous for page range]

english: Check the pages (the document has {count} pages)
backtrans: Check the pages (the document has {count} pages)

english: Couldn't find the page edges. Drag the corners.
target: Fant ikke sidekantene. Dra i hjørnene.
backtrans: Could not find the page edges. Drag the corners.

english: Enlarging doesn't add detail — the page may look soft.
target: Forstørring legger ikke til detaljer – siden kan se uskarp ut.
backtrans: Enlargement does not add details – the page may look blurry.

english: Delete {count} pages? They are removed when you save.
target: Slette {count} sider? De fjernes når du lagrer.
backtrans: Delete {count} pages? They are removed when you save.
Marg [??: truncated/odd word, presumably 'Margin' (Marg is not a standard Norwegian word; 'Marg' means marrow)]

english: Could not get under {mb} MB; sent the smallest version.
target: Kom ikke under {mb} MB; den minste versjonen ble sendt.
backtrans: Did not get below {mb} MB; the smallest version was sent.
